outcome: The Playnite provider now emits one BridgeState.lock-serialized schema-1 observation with boot/revision/episode, canonical game, exact process identity, window evidence, readiness and explicit evidence states.

Gateway exposes one authenticated parent/child observation route with actor/execution identity plus request, transition, operation, control-generation and actor-lease fences captured before and after the provider read.

Android strictly parses the envelope and uses one process-wide projection owner per host/actor/execution to reject delayed ordinals, stale revisions and retired boots, enforce local freshness and a non-resetting liveness deadline, and preserve known-live local transport under unknown evidence.

RetainedStreamSessionCoordinator now owns an independent monotonic transportGeneration; dashboard, transition, stop, resume, presentation and termination consumers use the shared projection and exact verified process proof.
Provider events are refresh/notification triggers only and cannot prove game, process, window or reveal readiness; expected-game fallback and obsolete Activity activePlayniteGame truth were removed.

post_edit_review_corrections.finding: An unavailable read could replace the active uncertain episode key and let the same episode reset its 15-second deadline when observations resumed.
post_edit_review_corrections.disposition: Fixed in ProjectionOwner: unavailable preserves an unresolved PENDING episode deadline, including the first accepted observation after an initially unavailable read. A controlled-clock accept/unavailable/accept regression reaches RECOVERY_REQUIRED at the original deadline.

post_edit_review_corrections.finding: Parser freshness incorrectly depended on Windows and Android wall clocks agreeing within fresh_for_ms.
post_edit_review_corrections.disposition: Fixed by treating producer wall time as diagnostic with only a 365-day absurd-timestamp bound. Freshness expires from the local monotonic acceptance clock; a six-hour skew plus local expiry regression passes.

post_edit_review_corrections.finding: The required recovery-to-next-Play production wiring sequence lacked deterministic coverage.
post_edit_review_corrections.disposition: Added a production-owner regression proving RECOVERY_REQUIRED does not close the live transport, stale control fencing rejects recovery, exact captured session/control/transport fencing authorizes reset, the late token is rejected, and the next Play carries a new operation, transition and transport generation. ConsoleActivity reconnect recovery now uses the exact captured Snapshot overload.
